card.name: Inside capitalized drug and warning names
card.fires_on: Partway through long words written in capital letters, such as GASTROINTESTINAL, NEOMYCIN, OXAPROZIN and THALOMID, mostly in label headings and warnings. It fires just before the word's ending is spelled out.

modes.label: GASTROINTESTINAL in warnings
modes.description: The RO in GASTROINTESTINAL inside the boxed cardiovascular and gastrointestinal events warning.
modes.example: RISK OF SERIOUS CARDIOVASCULAR AND GAST<<RO>>INTESTINAL EVENTS See full prescribing information

modes.label: Capitalized drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of an uppercase drug name such as NEOMYCIN, OXAPROZIN or THALOMID.

card.writes: It seems to push the next piece toward word starts with g, b or f, and away from endings like ide or ion.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long capitalized drug names and warning words, before the rest of the word is spelled.
